beats.map_pipeline_head: -- requirement pipeline (each requirement runs independently; jobs may run in parallel, gates and acceptance are serial) --
beats.map_note_split: (the parent becomes terminal split; children fall back to draft)
beats.map_note_merge: (sources become terminal merged; the new requirement falls back to draft)
beats.map_note_dropped: (keep_first: the abandoned side becomes terminal dropped)
beats.map_note_gate_plan: (**mandatory gate**: approve to develop; reject goes back to planning for a new plan)
beats.map_note_gate_accept: (**mandatory gate**: approve only on artifacts / gate evidence; reject keeps plan_ok → ready, an amended one falls back to planning)
beats.map_note_lane: (development lane; deps ready and no conflict)
beats.map_foot: always-on actions: config · map.show · requirement.add · requirement.list · lane.pool / lane.claim / lane.release (split / merge / amend / conflict / resolve are explicit main-agent commands)
beats.map_local_foot: (operation view: current node + selectable edges; map.show takes no payload)
beats.map_note_batch_boundary: (batch boundary: every leaf requirement is done, no pending proposals, no conflicts)
beats.map_note_batch_settle: (batch settle: archive -> run.batch+1 -> back to coordinate; resident)
beats.map_note_retire: (run retired - the only terminal edge, reachable only when run.retire is armed)
beats.map_note_profiles: [PROFILES] {{list}} (self-reported registry; the executor ledger stays the authority)
beats.map_note_run_begin: (章程三件套齐备才开工；run.begin 后章程锁定)
beats.map_note_settle_ready: (盘点四项齐备自动转发布——效应驱动，不是事件边)
beats.map_note_plan_submit: (plan 提案交付即门禁：提交后立刻升起计划门禁)
beats.map_note_integration: (集成幕：核验 develop@<sha> 后 confirm 落完成；reject 落待开发)
